back: An organisation of workers that acts to protect and improve their pay, conditions and job security.
Negotiation between a union, for all its members, and an employer over pay and conditions.
Pressure on an employer during a dispute: strike, go-slow, overtime ban.

front: Benefits to employees of union membership?
back: Strength in numbers, higher pay and better conditions, representation, legal advice, safety, job security.

front: Drawbacks to employees of union membership?
back: Subscriptions, lost pay during strikes, must follow majority decisions.
A trade union represents employees; a trade association represents businesses in one industry.

front: Effects of unions on a business?
back: One body to negotiate with and help with change; but higher wage costs and possible strikes or resistance.
An employee elected by union members in a workplace to represent them to managers.
